data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. Positive reviews on Google are generic and clustered, raising suspicion. Negative reviews on Google and lower Yelp rating contain highly specific, credible complaints about warranty failures and unresponsiveness. The company appears to deliver initially but fails to support products long-term.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star Google reviews posted same month (10 months ago) with similar generic praise
Lack of specific details in positive reviews (e.g., 'amazing service', 'great quality work' without project specifics)
No 3-4 star reviews in Google sample, creating a polarized distribution

negative_evidence: Multiple complaints about unresponsive warranty service: 'tried 3 times to get AAPNS to respond and come fix their substandard work', 'extremely difficult to even get a follow up status or call'
positive_evidence: One 5-star review mentions 'best warranties in the entire metroplex' and 'build guarantee gave us peace of mind'

authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (names: Lauren, Fred; timelines: 8 months, 3 years; amounts: $80k)
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity in complaints
BBB A+ rating with accreditation since 2016 indicates complaint resolution
Angi shows higher volume (64 reviews) with 4.5 rating, suggesting broader customer base
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.1) and Yelp (3.1) with similar review counts (14 each). This suggests different customer experiences or review solicitation patterns across platforms.

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Aquatic Arts Pool & Spa! From start to finish, they did exactly what they said they would—no surprises, no delays. Their build guarantee gave us peace of mind, and they absolutely hit the deadline as promised. They have one of the best warranties in the entire metroplex.The team was professional, reliable, and amazing to work with. We couldn’t be happier with our beautiful new pool! Highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality and integrity in pool construction.
reviews.author: Doris Richards

reviews.text:
We've had several leaks for almost 8 months. Not to mention, there were several delays in the actual pool construction in which we were extremely patient. Once we started notifying the company about the issues (post-construction), it's been extremely difficult to even get a follow up status or call. The representative who answers the calls (Lauren) tells us she will get with the construction manager (Fred) to get a status update, yet we've received a call back about 10% of the time only to tell us they are still "working on it". After 3 months of us constantly calling, they sent a leak detection specialist that confirmed the initial leak was coming from the pipes behind the water features. This also caused damage to the water features and they have to be re-constructed as the cement had expanded due to the moisture. After two additional months of us repeatedly complaining, they sent a contractor without notifying us. The contractor walked straight to our back yard without announcing himself.
When we asked who he was, he told us he was there to do a quote for redoing the water features and fixing the leak.
Once he was done, he told us Aquatic Arts would call us within a week to schedule construction. Needless to say, we did not get a follow up. Several weeks ago, we sent a written notice to request the issue be resolved or we would have to seek legal action, the same day Fred comes to our house and ensures us he is personally going to take care of it by sealing the leaks in the water feature and replacing the auto return that had started to leak. He ensured us he would be back that same week. After several requests for updates, we are still not getting anywhere and are dealing with severe leaks that are getting worse and has inflated our water bill over the last several months. Our texts and verbal requests for updates are blatantly being ignored. This company does not honor the warranty. The Polaris pool pump is now also leaking.
Please avoid going with this company for your pool build.
reviews.author: Ashley Burdette

reviews.text:
Buyer beware. Not a quality company.

I spent $80k+ in 2021 with AAPNS to build my pool and spa. I also referred my neighbor and she installed a pool.

Fast forward 3 years later and the tile work on the pool is completely falling apart…the concrete they use for the travertine tiles has turned to gritty sand and the tiles around my spa and water features have come off.

I have tried 3 times to get AAPNS to respond and come fix their substandard work but have not received a response.

They only warranty their work for 1 year so that they can do a low quality job and get away with it.

I would not recommend doing business with this company.
reviews.author: AJ Nielson

reviews.text: Aquatic arts is awesome! The best designs. So professional. Their pools and backyard scapes look great! We love ours!
reviews.author: Kerry Shepherd

reviews.text: Useless and unreliable. Spoke with them over the phone to let them know wants and budget BEFORE setting up a time to get a quote. Was told everything is doable in our budget, and had a meeting with a sales rep who came out to our home and went in detail of ideas for an HOUR. We were told it would be about two weeks for the prepared estimate. Nothing. Called and left a message a month later. No call back. Got a text from a sales rep - was for the wrong customer, not us. Asked them to check on our estimate -  no contact after that. Called AGAIN to see about getting the estimate, was told someone would in touch. Nothing. Completely ghosted. Terrible company, extremely unprofessional and unorganized.
reviews.author: Staci Pettit

reviews.text: Amazing company and great quality work! We loved working with AAPNS. Also very family friendly people.
reviews.author: Fayth Lyons

reviews.text: Couldn't have been happier with the entire process. Would definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: Nikki B

reviews.text: Beautiful work amazing service such sweet people!
reviews.author: Maddy Knowles
